description:
Inbound: an operator reports its Neon store is 402-locked.

Called MCP-to-MCP by the operator's runtime the instant it catches a
Neon HTTP 402 on its own database. Verifies the operator controls
``npub`` (inline Schnorr bound to this tool's wire name), records a
durable latest-state row, and fires a best-effort owner-notification
DM. This is how the Authority learns the store is dark BEFORE a patron
files a complaint.

detail.description: Short, credential-free error summary (the Neon 402 message).

dpop_token.description: Inline kind-27235 proof signed by the operator's nsec, bound to this tool's wire name. The operator's runtime mints and sends this automatically when it catches a Neon 402.

npub.description: The reporting operator's Nostr npub (the one whose store is locked).

name: authority_receive_neon_402_alert
